summary: Preserve task and read-loan attribution across blocking callbacks and expose process CPU, bounded reconcile stage costs, and completed read-loan duration.

schema.detail: No durable or wire schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Telemetry adds process CPU, metrics-gated reconcile stage CPU and duration, and read-loan duration counters. Blocking callbacks install their originating task and read-loan origin before reader acquisition, without retaining thread-local guards across awaits. Diagnostic snapshot tokens do not add duplicate physical-loan duration.

downtime.detail: No migration or coordinated downtime is required.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes; ordinary binary rollback applies.
